title: Signature-description resource identifier behavior

included: Argument validation and status returned by the resource-identifier interface.
Selection of a candidate or category fallback resource identifier.
excluded: Operating-system resource lookup and locale fallback beyond the stated dependency call.
Meaning and original names of the seven analyst-numbered categories.
non_goals: This revision does not specify a Windows-compatible replacement DLL.
This revision does not supply or authorize copying resource payloads.
Analyst terms do not claim recovery of original source-level names.

platform_constraints: The observed interface uses the Microsoft x64 ABI on little-endian AMD64 Windows.
Status values and integer arithmetic are interpreted as 32-bit values unless stated otherwise.
Resource existence is determined through a two-UTF-16-code-unit string lookup using the module's saved handle.

terms.meaning: An analyst label for the signed selector values 1 through 7; original semantic names are unknown.
The category's first identifier plus the unsigned value input.
A category-specific identifier selected when the value is outside the category span or the candidate string is absent.

interfaces.name: MpGetSignatureDescriptionResourceIdentifier
interfaces.summary: Select a string-resource identifier for a category and unsigned value.
interfaces.abi: Microsoft x64 ABI; uint32 status; int32 category; uint32 value; writable uint32 output pointer

inputs.name: value
inputs.meaning: Zero-based value within a category span.

inputs.name: out_identifier
inputs.meaning: Destination for the selected resource identifier.

outputs.name: status
outputs.meaning: Zero on a completed selection or 0x80070057 for invalid arguments.

outputs.name: out_identifier
outputs.meaning: Candidate or category fallback on success.

preconditions: A non-null output pointer must identify writable storage for one uint32 value.

interfaces.name: GetMpAsDescModuleHandle
interfaces.summary: Return the complete pointer-width value held in the module's saved-handle state.
interfaces.abi: Microsoft x64 ABI; no arguments; pointer-width return

outputs.name: saved_handle
outputs.meaning: Current 64-bit saved module-handle value, including zero.

requirements.title: Reject invalid selector and destination arguments
requirements.statement: The interface MUST return 0x80070057 when category is less than or equal to zero, category is greater than or equal to eight, or out_identifier is null.
conditions: The signed category comparison is applied before any category-table access.
A non-null pointer is not otherwise validated by this contract.
outputs: For an invalid category with a writable non-null out_identifier, the pointed value remains unchanged.
errors: Return 0x80070057 for every invalid condition in scope.
ordering: Validation precedes category-table and resource access.
requirements.test_oracle: Exercise category values below, at, and above both bounds with null and writable outputs; compare status and output preservation.

requirements.title: Use the reviewed category ranges and fallbacks
requirements.statement: For categories 1 through 7, the interface MUST use the respective triples (first, exclusive limit, fallback): (1000, 2000, 1027), (2000, 3000, 2027), (3000, 4000, 3063), (4000, 5000, 4002), (5000, 6000, 5002), (6000, 7000, 6002), and (7000, 8000, 7005).
conditions: The value input is compared as uint32 with exclusive_limit minus first.
outputs: An out-of-span value selects the category fallback identifier.
errors: No error status is produced solely because a value is out of span.
side_effects: On success, exactly one uint32 result is written to out_identifier.
ordering: Range selection follows successful argument validation.
requirements.test_oracle: For every category, test zero, the last in-span value, the exclusive span, and uint32 maximum with controlled resource availability.

requirements.title: Probe in-span candidate strings and fall back when absent
requirements.statement: For an in-span value, the interface MUST look up the string at first plus value using the saved module handle and a capacity of two UTF-16 code units; a nonzero lookup count selects the candidate, while zero selects the fallback.
conditions: The lookup count, rather than a last-error value or returned text content, determines presence.
outputs: Write the candidate identifier when lookup count is nonzero; otherwise write the fallback identifier; return zero in both cases.
errors: A missing candidate is a successful fallback selection, not an interface error.
side_effects: One resource lookup occurs only for an in-span value.
ordering: The output is selected after the resource lookup result is known.
requirements.test_oracle: Stub resource lookup to return zero and nonzero for each candidate and assert identifier, status, handle, identifier, and capacity observations.

requirements.title: Return the full saved handle
requirements.statement: The accessor MUST return the complete 64-bit saved-handle value without truncation.
outputs: Return zero when saved state is zero and preserve every bit of a nonzero 64-bit value.
errors: No distinct error result is specified.
ordering: No ordering constraint beyond reading the current saved state is specified.
requirements.test_oracle: Set controlled saved state to zero and to a value with nonzero high bits, then assert the exact return.

evidence_claims.claim: Manual bounded review supports the validation, unsigned range, resource-count, candidate, fallback, output-write, and return behaviors stated here.
evidence_claims.limitations: Optional tracing callees, module initialization, and operating-system resource fallback were outside the reviewed behavior.

evidence_claims.claim: The seven reviewed category records contain the exact first, exclusive-limit, and fallback values stated in REQ-MPASDESC-RANGES.
evidence_claims.limitations: Category meanings and original source-level names are not encoded by this observation.

evidence_claims.claim: A portable analysis model and controlled original execution agreed for 21,180 combinations covering categories, boundary values, resource availability, statuses, output values, lookup identifiers, saved handles, and lookup capacity.
evidence_claims.limitations: The comparison used a stubbed string lookup and disabled tracing; it did not load the module through Windows.

evidence_claims.claim: Controlled execution returned exact zero and exact nonzero 64-bit saved-state values from the accessor.
evidence_claims.limitations: Initialization, lifetime, and whether every runtime value is a valid operating-system handle were not tested.

unknowns.statement: The semantic meaning and original type names for categories 1 through 7 are unknown.
unknowns.impact: Public names must remain neutral and compatibility claims cannot assign category semantics.

unknowns.statement: Optional tracing calls and provider state are not behaviorally specified.
unknowns.impact: A conforming implementation of this draft cannot claim tracing compatibility.

unknowns.statement: Module initialization, saved-handle lifetime, and real locale fallback are unverified.
unknowns.impact: This draft is insufficient for a replacement DLL or end-to-end resource-loading claim.
